relationships.subject: Paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: Administration of paclitaxel for four days resulted in a significant upregulation of C3aR1 in DRG from WT rats (Fig.2) and mice (Fig.3).

relationships.subject: C3aR1
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicate that paclitaxel-induced upregulation of TRPV4 in DRG is dependent on C3aR1 signaling.

relationships.subject: C3aR1
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that paclitaxel-induced DRG macrophage expansion is also C3aR1 dependent.

key_findings: Paclitaxel upregulates C3aR1 on DRG macrophages, which drives TRPV4 upregulation, macrophage expansion and PIMA.
C3aR1 antagonist attenuated PIMA, DRG neuron hyperexcitability and intraepidermal nerve fiber loss, and further protected TRPV4 KO mice.
